:::{#exm-kronecker-product}
#### A Kronecker product

For $\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}$
and $\matr{B} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\matr{A} \otimes \matr{B}
&= \begin{bmatrix}
1 \cd \matr{B} & 2 \cd \matr{B} \\
3 \cd \matr{B} & 4 \cd \matr{B}
\end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(definition of the Kronecker product)} \\
&= \begin{bmatrix}
0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\
0 & 3 & 0 & 4
\end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(multiply each entry of } \matr{A} \text{ by } \matr{B} \text{)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The result is $2 \times 4$:
$\matr{A}$ is $2 \times 2$ and $\matr{B}$ is $1 \times 2$,
so $\matr{A} \otimes \matr{B}$ is $(2 \cd 1) \times (2 \cd 2)$.
